title: Taiwan's leading DRAM maker Nanya Technology expects its capex to hit ~$6.2B in 2027, up 4x YoY, and reports unaudited Q2 revenue of ~$2.6B, up 684% YoY (Wen-Yee Lee/Reuters)
summary: Wen-Yee Lee / Reuters: Taiwan's leading DRAM maker Nanya Technology expects its capex to hit ~$6.2B in 2027, up 4x YoY, and reports unaudited Q2 revenue of ~$2.6B, up 684% YoY — Taiwanese memory chipmaker Nanya Technology (2408.TW) said on Friday it plans capital spending of more than T$200 billion ($6.2 billion) …
